text: The Patriots' catastrophic 35-6 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday has prompted some serious soul-searching, particularly from Drake Maye, whose three turnovers (two interceptions and a lost fumble) epitomized an offensive performance he himself labeled "unacceptable" as he looks inward for answers going forward. Trevor Lawrence torched New England's defense with three touchdown passes in what amounted to a statement win for the Jaguars, raising fresh questions about whether Maye can overcome his early-season struggles and lead this offense effectively. On the defensive side, second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas continues to make impact plays and will remain a key contributor, while the secondary got a boost from Marcus Jones, who notched his first interception of the season—small bright spots in an otherwise dismal afternoon. The Patriots were without tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder), both officially inactive after carrying questionable designations into Sunday's matchup in Jacksonville.
